name: Should I repair or replace my existing bathroom vanity and cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my existing bathroom vanity and cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace your bathroom vanity and cabinets depends on their current condition and your long-term goals. If there's minor damage, such as a loose hinge or a small scratch, repairs might be a cost-effective solution. However, if there's significant water damage, structural issues, or if you're looking for a complete aesthetic overhaul and improved functionality, replacement is usually the better option. We can assess your current setup and provide recommendations based on your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor damage, but replace if there's significant damage, structural issues, or if you desire a complete aesthetic and functional upgrade.
